description.value:
Duration while the duel lasts

You have watched this one long enough now that it has stopped being able to surprise you.

Once you have attacked your marked target in three separate rounds this encounter, you become permanently aware of its position while it is within 60 feet, whether or not it is hidden or invisible, and it can never be concealed from you again this encounter. It gains no benefit from being undetected by you.

cinderfall.incomplete: After 3 rounds attacking the mark: permanently see it though hidden/invisible, and it gains nothing from being undetected against the caster. No rule element counts "rounds in which the caster attacked a specific creature" -- a dynamic per-target counter with no analog anywhere in the engine -- and Sense's selector field is a closed enum (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/sense.ts:23) with no entry for "see one specific creature regardless of concealment." This class's own target:mark:<slug> predicate idiom (deadhand.call-the-room-effect.json, etc.) is also unfireable here: no card anywhere in this corpus ever applies a mark:<slug> option to a target actor.
